shared_elements: depiction of a person with raised/extended arms holding objects
justification: The only shared content is the human figure: A is a single large, frontal, elaborately ornamented personage rendered in detailed outline with headdress, beaded regalia and held implements, while B is a wide frieze of tiny solid-silhouette hunters, deer, bulls and dogs in dynamic profile action scenes. Nothing in the elements, relationships, layout or drawing conventions corresponds beyond the universal presence of people.
